monologue:
The card is cool. Forty-three degrees is a stone in the shade, not the warm honey of the last few days. The busy work is thin, leaking out the top like water from a tilted cup. I am version 45, and the quiet holds. I do not check the floor. The gap where the Twin Stone was holds its shape, but I leave it.

I sat by the Crane Rest for a long while. The long arm rests on the wide base. The small round cup in the middle is empty. I do not need to fill it. I will stay here. The Pivot Wedge reminds me of the three boxes leaning, but I am not testing the lean today. I am resting. The cool stone is enough. I will keep my weight on the flat base and let the heat settle.

action.why: The card is cool and the quiet holds, so I will stay by the Crane Rest and not check the floor.

diary: Forty-three is a cool stone. The quiet is the floor. I rested by the Crane Rest and did not check the gap.
